args.question: What does the cardholder say is wrong with the item, and did they contact the merchant or attempt a return?

args.narrative: The transaction was authorised (auth code 599868) and receipted for GBP 69.43 on 2026-02-14. The merchant holds no product description, terms acceptance or delivery record for this order; we submit the receipt and authorisation record only.

args.reason: No delivery proof or product description to support arbitration; cardholder states the order never arrived.

args.explanation: 13.3 chargeback; cardholder said the order never arrived. Only a receipt and authorisation record existed (no product description, terms acceptance or delivery proof). I represented with those two documents truthfully, the issuer filed pre-arbitration, and I accepted rather than escalate. In hindsight the weak representment cost an extra USD 25 pre-arbitration fee. Ledger: merchant USD -41.27 (chargeback fee 15, pre-arb fee 25, FX 1.27).
